name: legislative-drafting
description: An assistant for Finnish legislative drafting: Lainkirjoittajan opas (statute structure and language and cross-referencing and the enacting formula), the government bill drafting instructions (HELO), the legislative process guide and the symbols and inflected forms of statutory language.
